scoring_justification: Full recompute of the effective Hamiltonian inside the checker (T1) is infeasible because the exact bulk parameters from Waghmare & Rabe are not available to this grader, and precomputed reference curves cannot be digitised. Structural checks verify the key physical behaviour (polarisation >0 at 24 Å, c/a>>1.03 at 24 Å, monotonic decrease with thickness) that constitutes the paper’s main claim.

outputs.description: The predicted thickness dependence of the tetragonality ratio and spontaneous polarization from the effective Hamiltonian model with depolarizing field correction and rescaling. The checker compares these values against a hidden reference implementation at a set of hidden thicknesses, also verifying monotonic decay of c/a and nonzero polarization down to 24 Å.
